title: Academy CRM

provisional.stages: The Admissions stages below are a working guess for testing the screens. They are NOT agreed business requirements until Admissions validates them.
provisional.documents: The document checklist is taken from what the current admissions file tracks. Which of these the CRM should own, and which only mirror another system, is not decided.
provisional.owners: Admissions is the only owner of a person. Marketing brings leads in and that shows in the source and campaign, not in ownership.

2026.source: 0. NJK KPI 2026.xlsx, sheet Admissions, B2: "140 new students (70% in Officer Programs)". Officer Programs = NAV + ENG: Ritvars, 05.10.2026 (via MASTER CONTROL).

realData._note: current-cycle = open leads whose first contact is in `year`, plus the most recent `maxAdmitted` admitted students so the end of the journey is visible. Not proceeding and older years are left in the file and not loaded.

_startWith: empty | real | synthetic. Empty is the demo: the table holds nobody until a channel test writes somebody into it.

items.label: Send the admission terms and the price
Call back
items._why: Ritvars 02.10.2026: a known lead whose call nobody answered goes to Today. The phone sync plans this step itself, due when they rang; one at a time per person.

Remind them to apply in SIS

_stepGroupsByStage: Ritvars 02.10.2026: the steps offered depend on the lead's stage, by group, so the list is shorter and what cannot happen yet is not shown. A step marked anyStage fits every stage. The step already planned is always kept. MVP: Admissions tunes it here by using it, a config edit and never code.
_nextActions: Next action is mandatory everywhere. Every option drives towards one of: a visit on site, an application in SIS with documents, or payment. Provisional wording until Admissions confirms it.
_statusFollowsEvents: Completing a step moves the person to the stage that step belongs to, forwards only, and the move is written on the timeline. Not proceeding is never automatic: somebody has to decide that.
_owners: Locked principle 23.09.2026: ownership follows the CURRENT STAGE of the person. It is not permanently assigned to one person. The stage list and the stage-to-owner map are NOT decided, so the prototype still lets a user set the owner by hand.

_ownerPeople._note: Who holds each role, said 23.09.2026. The interface shows the ROLE - "Admissions" - and never the person. None of the three is an admin.

_admins: The three admins are Aigars, Ritvars and Marina. Admin is a LEVEL OF ACCESS, and the prototype has no login, so picking a name in the sidebar is a setting and not an identity check. Being an admin is not the same as being able to read the feedback inbox - see feedbackReaders, which is deliberately a shorter list.
historyHonesty: There is no login in this prototype. Who you are is a setting in the sidebar, not a check. The admin rule is shown so it can be judged, not enforced - that waits for authentication.

editPolicy._note: Everything about the person as they are now may be corrected. Where they came from and when we first heard from them are historical facts and stay locked. Every change is written to the history: field, old value, new value, who, when.
editPolicy._amended: 24.09.2026: nationality added. It is a thing somebody ASKS and types, exactly like education, and it was missing only because nobody had made a box for it. It is never derived from a name, a phone prefix or anything else.

_accountsNote: Real sign-in addresses. NOTHING here is guessed: manage_users.mjs used to build first.last@novikontas.org from a display name and produced ritvars@ for a person whose address is ritvars.vilcins@. A name is not an address. Anybody missing from this list has no address recorded yet and gets no account. Each account names the environment variable its password comes from, in passwordEnv - the same shape channels.json uses for secretEnv. The NAME lives here; the VALUE lives only in the host environment and is never written down, logged or committed. The name says WHO, not what role they hold, so a role change never makes the variable lie.

accounts.name: Admissions
accounts._note: THE SHARED ADMISSIONS ACCOUNT. Ieva and Laura both work from it - it is the Admissions mailbox and the Gmail channel inbox, and signing in with it is a normal, intended way for either of them to use the CRM. It is role user because Admissions work needs no channel configuration, which is the same rule every other admissions person is under; it is not a lesser account. What it does carry is that an entry made from it reads "Admissions" rather than "Ieva" or "Laura", so where the history has to name the individual, that person signs in as themselves.

_users: Locked 23.09.2026. Arina was added when the phone menu was mapped: she answers button 3 with Tetiana. No email addresses yet and no authentication - identity is a setting until a login exists. A role is NOT a person.
_ownershipFollowsStage: Set to true once the stage list and the stage-to-owner map exist. While it is false the owner is set by hand and the screens say so.
_noteTypes: Locked 23.09.2026: a note carries a type so it can be read and reported on, and it stays in the same single history as everything else. No separate note screens.
_closedReasonsByStage: Ritvars 02.10.2026: the reasons offered depend on the stage the person leaves, so the list is shorter and what cannot have happened yet is not offered. Every entry is one of closedReasons, which the server still enforces whole. MVP, provisional until Admissions has used it.
_closedReasons: Provisional until Admissions validates the list. "Not proceeding" cannot be set without a reason, and "Other" cannot be set without an explanation.

lifecycle._note: Locked 23.09.2026: one person record from lead to admitted student. Becoming an applicant or being admitted NEVER creates a second record, because conversion has to stay measurable on the same row. At Admitted the person is handed over to the SIS. The CRM does recruitment and admissions; it does not become the student information system.

duplicateRule._note: Locked 23.09.2026: a duplicate is never created silently. A match on email, on the last 8 digits of the phone, or on the exact full name stops the save and shows the existing record. The operator either opens that record, or states in as many words that this is a different person.

_searchFields: Locked 23.09.2026: the operator finds a person by whatever detail they remember. The source channel matches on its plain name too, so "Instagram" finds an Instagram lead without anybody knowing the internal channel id.

todayGroups.label: New leads
todayGroups.what: Arrived and nobody has spoken to them yet

todayGroups.label: Waiting on us
todayGroups.what: A step we planned that is due, or a message they sent that has not been answered

todayGroups.label: Without Next Action
todayGroups.what: Active people with no next step at all

_todayGroups: Locked 23.09.2026, amended 24.09.2026. The order is the user choice and is remembered. Re-ordering NEVER hides a group - an empty group still shows, saying it is clear. Each group shows done/total for the day so a cleared queue reads as cleared. AMENDMENT: Follow-ups and Replies were merged into one "Waiting on us" queue. They were two tabs answering the same question, and somebody with a due step AND an unanswered message was listed twice. Each row still says which of the two put it there, because the action differs. RENAMED 25.09.2026: "Other attention" said nothing. It is the people who are active with NO next step, so nothing will ever surface them again - the tab that stops somebody being quietly forgotten. Named "Without Next Action" by Ritvars, with a monochrome warning glyph rather than a colour emoji.
_coreMetrics: Locked 23.09.2026 as the starting three. The admissions reporting dimensions (applications, admitted, stage, programme, study form, education background, nationality, intake channel, admission duration) are REQUIREMENTS TO INVESTIGATE, not an approved dashboard. Nationality is not in the prototype schema at all.

levels.label: Not clear yet
levels.what: Somebody wrote to us and we cannot tell yet whether they want to study.

levels.label: Lead
levels.what: They told us what they want to study. This is Admissions work.

warmToHotThreshold.status: PROVISIONAL - NOT a final business rule
warmToHotThreshold._note: A named programme of interest makes it a lead. Everything else is "not clear yet". Configurable: change leadWhen and the machine changes with it. The machine still only SUGGESTS - a person confirms the interest, and confirming it is what routes it.

qualification._warmToHotThreshold: PROVISIONAL. The ROUTING is what matters and it is settled: confirmed interest -> Admissions, everything else -> Marketing.
qualification._note: Simplified 23.09.2026 after the first visual review. Raw / Warm / Hot read as jargon on screen and told nobody anything. There are two states: we cannot tell yet (Marketing), or they said what they want to study (Admissions). The ladder is still separate from the pipeline stage list.
qualification._criticalFields: Only the programme of interest is critical. Everything else may be missing at HOT and is shown as "missing information" for a human to complete. Incompleteness never blocks promotion.

unclear._note: Tetiana sees a queue. Admissions is never interrupted by it.

lead._note: This is the one that means something.

notifications._ageingDays: An untouched contact surfaces the next day at 09:00.

levels.what: the person typed it into our own form
a machine read it out of a message and nobody has confirmed it
a named operator looked at the extraction and agreed
a named operator typed it themselves

fieldProvenance._note: An extracted value is a SUGGESTION until a human confirms it. It is shown differently on screen and is excluded from every count and report. Without this rule "the machine must not invent facts" is a wish; with it an unconfirmed guess cannot become a statistic.

inboundStorage._storeMessageBodies: Decided 23.09.2026: V1 does NOT store full Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp or Gmail conversation bodies. The cost is that an extraction error becomes uncheckable - we keep our reading of the message but not the message. Whether to keep a body UNTIL the qualification decision and delete it after is an open question in docs/INBOUND_ARCHITECTURE.md section 9.

bodyLifecycle._note: DECIDED 23.09.2026. The body exists only while somebody is qualifying the item. The moment the item is qualified or archived the body is deleted and only the structured record survives. A test asserts the body is gone and the extracted fields are not.

browserExtension._note: Demoted 23.09.2026. Marketing works on a phone across four apps, so a desktop browser extension does not fit how the work happens. It stays on the shelf as a fallback only if a provider approval is refused outright. The product is not designed around it.

unresearchedChannels.label: LinkedIn
unresearchedChannels.research: NONE. Deliberately kept out of config/providers.json so it cannot look investigated.

unresearchedChannels.label: TikTok
unresearchedChannels.research: NONE. Named 23.09.2026, nothing checked. Kept out of config/providers.json.

_stageRoles: The stage VOCABULARY is provisional and will be replaced. The code never writes a stage name; it asks for the stage that plays a role (admitted, closed, ...). Changing config.stages and these four pointers changes the whole product, with no architectural rework. A test fails if a stage role points at a stage that does not exist.

ageing._note: DECIDED 23.09.2026. An untouched raw contact surfaces the NEXT DAY at 09:00 local. Inbound Monday 21:30 surfaces Tuesday 09:00. Deterministic, computed once on arrival and stored on the row, so it can be tested without waiting for a clock.

intake._note: Every inbound item lands here first. Nothing becomes a lead on its own. Archiving keeps the row forever, searchable, with the reason and who did it.

routing.rule: a confirmed interest routes to Admissions; everything else stays with Marketing
routing._note: Decided 23.09.2026 at the visual review. Marketing is NOT a second admissions desk: Tetiana answers one question, "is this a real prospective student or not". The moment somebody has told us what they want to study, it is Admissions work - including a question about documents or price, which is exactly what Admissions answers.

channelAccess._note: Corrected 24.09.2026. PER PERSON, because no role-shaped model can express it: WhatsApp is Ieva, Laura and Marina but NOT Tetiana. Facebook, Instagram and Messenger are worked through the shared Meta Business Suite. LinkedIn and TikTok are Tetiana alone. Arina has NO social access and is phone button 3 backup only. CHANNEL ACCESS IS NOT ADMISSIONS OWNERSHIP.
channelAccess._roleAccessIsDerived: A role can reach a channel when at least one person holding that role can. Never write a role list by hand - it would drift from the people.

handoverRule.onGap: flag and require a next action
handoverRule.gapAction: Ask Marketing for an email or phone, or have Marketing relay the reply
handoverRule._note: A lead on a channel its owner cannot open is a crack. Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp are shared, so they are usually fine. LinkedIn and TikTok are Tetiana only, so a lead from there needs an email or a phone, or Marketing has to relay. It never blocks the promotion - blocking would lose the lead.

intakeFilter._note: Obvious junk never enters the working queue. It is filtered on arrival, kept in the database and findable, but nobody has to archive it by hand. A message from a real person that simply says "Hi" is NOT junk and does still enter the queue - see the open question in docs/BACKLOG.md.

tabs.label: CAR
tabs.hint: Channel Automation Results - everything the channels brought in

ui._note: Cut at the first visual review. Funnel, Reports and Metrics were three screens answering one question, so they are one screen called Reports. Intake became CAR. The demo shelf is DEV CONTROL and nothing in it is part of the daily job.

whatsapp._note: Access is shared, but whether WhatsApp is actually connected to Meta Business Suite in the Novikontas setup has NOT been verified. Do not claim it is part of the Meta integration until somebody checks.

channelSources._note: The CRM does not model individuals operating a social account. Facebook and Instagram arrive through one shared operational inbox, Meta Business Suite. The channel records stay SEPARATE for reporting, because "where did this person come from" is still Facebook or Instagram. LinkedIn and TikTok have no shared inbox, so Tetiana is the access bridge for those two and only those two.

emailFilter.decided: Ritvars 01.10.2026 (popup A, after the first real edu@ read: 40 emails, most automatic or internal): automatic senders and our own domains are set aside with the reason, kept, never deleted; everyone else goes to the Inbox.

phoneFilter.decided: Ritvars 01.10.2026: there will be filtration before calls become New Leads; build it now. An unknown caller still goes to New Leads, where staff assess interest; nobody is a lead until a person qualifies them.

phoneMenu._note: The caller presses 1, 2 or 3 and the PBX puts them on the matching queue. Those three queue names are exactly what lib/pbx.js keeps and everything else it drops, so the menu and the logger are one fact in one place.
phoneMenu._answered: The PBX event carries a `queue` field and the queue IS the button. This was in the original TeleGroup brief and was mapped here on 23.09.2026. Nobody needs to ask TeleGroup whether the button is included - it is. What is still needed is an API token.

_historyReaders: Ritvars 04.10.2026: 'Ieva is the main user, she needs to see the full picture.' She signs in as edu@novikontas.org, named Admissions; Ieva is her seat on a copy without sign-in. These see the whole log and every correction, like an admin, without being admins. Everybody else not an admin still sees only their own actions (23.09).
_feedbackReaders: Decided 24.09.2026. Feedback sent from inside the app is read by Aigars and Ritvars ONLY. Marina is an admin and still must not see it, which is why this is a separate list and not derived from admins. Feedback is stored in this machine s own database and is never emailed or sent to any outside service. Enforcement is a real check on every feedback route, but with no login it can only check the name that is selected, not prove who selected it.
_channelAliases: The simulator and older records name some channels differently: website_form is the Website, gmail is Email, open_day is the Open Day, and klatiene is In person. These are the SAME channel, so they are aliases rather than entries in channels - otherwise a filter would offer the same thing twice under two names. A test fails if an alias and a channel key collide.
_admissionsOwner: LOCKED 24.09.2026. Once something becomes a confirmed Admissions case the owner is Admissions, and the person who holds that role is IEVA - whatever channel it arrived on. Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Gmail, Website, Google Form, Open Day, Phone, Agent, LinkedIn, TikTok, in person: all of them. Laura, Tetiana and Marina may open the record and act on it; that does not move ownership. Channel access is not ownership.
_nationalities: Typed in by whoever is talking to the person, exactly like education. It is NOT derived from anything and never guessed from a name or a phone prefix. The list is a shortcut, not a closed set - "Other" exists because it has to.
_educationAliases: The admissions export was typed by hand over years, in two languages, so the same school appears as Vidusskola and Secondary, and Jurskola and Maritime school. These are mapped on IMPORT so a report can count them. The source file is never edited.
_maritimeEducations: Which education values count as a maritime school graduate, for the KPI that asks for that number. PROVISIONAL: Ieva confirms the list. LJA is Latvijas Juras akademija and LJK is Liepajas Jurniecibas koledza.

suggestedNextAction._note: What the dialog offers FIRST. It is a suggestion and nothing more: the whole list is still there and anything can be picked. The order it is read in is question, then channel, then whether a programme is known. Changing any of this is a config edit, never a code change, because the right first move is Admissions business and not ours. PROVISIONAL until Ieva says what she would actually do first.
suggestedNextAction._dates: A "when / deadline" question gets Answer the question, not a programme description. Admission is open all year, so the useful reply is that they can apply whenever they are ready. A brochure does not say that and the question comes back.

_admissionIsYearRound: LOCKED 24.09.2026, told by Ritvars. Novikontas accepts submissions ALL YEAR ROUND. There is no application deadline and no single intake date. This matters more than it looks: somebody asking "what is the deadline" is carrying a wrong assumption, and the reply is to correct it, not to look a date up. Nothing in this CRM may imply a closing date.

metaBusinessSuite._note: CONFIRMED by Ritvars 24.09.2026: all four channels are reached through Meta Business Suite, and an Instagram account inside Business Suite is by definition a Professional account, so that is not a separate thing to check. Arina has NO social access and is phone button 3 backup only. Tetiana administers the Suite (25.09.2026).

pbxTokenNotRotated.question: Should the PBX token used during discovery be changed?
pbxTokenNotRotated.answer: NO. It will not be changed.
pbxTokenNotRotated.note: Asked and answered. Raised again after it was decided and Ritvars had to repeat it three times.

pbxQueueIsTheButton.question: Does the PBX event say which menu button the caller pressed?
pbxQueueIsTheButton.answer: YES. The event carries a `queue` field and the queue IS the button. It was in the original TeleGroup brief.
pbxQueueIsTheButton.note: Mapped in phoneMenu since 23.09.2026. Listed as an open question by mistake.

metaAccessConfirmed.question: Who has Meta Business Suite access?
metaAccessConfirmed.answer: Ieva, Laura, Tetiana and Marina. Arina has none.

instagramIsProfessional.question: Is the Instagram account a Professional account?
instagramIsProfessional.answer: YES, necessarily: it is in Meta Business Suite, and an account in Business Suite is a Professional account.

admissionIsYearRound.question: Is there an application deadline?
admissionIsYearRound.answer: NO. Submissions are accepted all year round.

settled._what: Questions Ritvars has ANSWERED. Anything with doNotReopen must never appear again as an open question, a blocker, or a checkbox in any document or report. A test fails if it does. This exists because open questions were being regenerated from notes written BEFORE the answers arrived, so his answers existed and the summaries did not read them.

mailchimpWebhooksAvailable.question: Does the Novikontas Mailchimp plan include webhooks?
mailchimpWebhooksAvailable.answer: YES. Checked against the live account on 24.09.2026: the webhooks endpoint for the Novikontas audience returns 200 and zero webhooks are configured, so we simply add one.
mailchimpWebhooksAvailable.decidedBy: Checked directly against the Mailchimp API
mailchimpWebhooksAvailable.note: Account "Novikontas", monthly plan, 2,827 subscribers. Audience c6ab4facba, 2,779 members.

whatsappNumber.question: Which phone number do we use for WhatsApp Business?
whatsappNumber.note: This removes the INPUT blocker only. The Meta side still has to be built: WABA, register the number, app, webhook. That is work, not a question.

phoneButtonsConfirmed.question: Is the 1 / 2 / 3 button routing on the phone line correct?
phoneButtonsConfirmed.answer: YES. Confirmed as the existing live setup.
phoneButtonsConfirmed.note: Together with pbxQueueIsTheButton this closes the phone routing entirely. The PBX API already exposes the queue, and the queue is the button.

workspaceAdmin.question: Who is the Google Workspace administrator?
workspaceAdmin.note: She is the only person who can grant the service account domain-wide delegation to read edu@novikontas.org. Everything on our side of Gmail is already built.

teleGroupTokenHeld.question: Do we have a TeleGroup API token?
teleGroupTokenHeld.note: The VALUE is not recorded here and must never be. It goes straight into the server setting PBX_API_TOKEN on the host, and belongs in Bitwarden. It is not the discovery token and it is not being changed either - see pbxTokenNotRotated.

metaAdministeredByTetiana.question: Who administers the Meta Business Suite?
metaAdministeredByTetiana.note: Access is Ieva, Laura, Tetiana and Marina; Tetiana is the one who holds it. She is who creates the app at developers.facebook.com and submits it for App Review.

googleFormDropped.question: Who created the Google Form, and so owns its response sheet?
googleFormDropped.answer: It does not matter. The Google Form channel is DROPPED from the product.
googleFormDropped.note: The website Application form button opened a Google Form. The application path is apply.novikontas.org, which is downstream in the lifecycle and is not a channel. Restated 02.10 when the Channels screen was still asking who owns the form. The adapter and the Apps Script stay in the repository; the channel does not exist. See docs/CHANNEL_RECONCILIATION_2026-10-02.md.

openQuestions._what: The ONLY things nobody at Novikontas has answered yet. Everything else is in `settled`. The Desktop guide and every readiness document are generated from THIS list, so a question that has been answered cannot come back.
openQuestions._rule: Before adding one: check `settled` first. If it is there, it is answered.

spamWords.ask: What rubbish actually arrives on Instagram and Facebook?
spamWords.why: The spam list is a guess until somebody who reads the messages every day adds to it. It is a configuration line, not code.

agentPartnerOwner.ask: Which agent do we start with, and who at their end sets up the link?
agentPartnerOwner.why: The agent channel needs one partner to begin with and a token issued for them alone. The agent is a SOURCE, never the owner of the person.

linkedinLeadSync.ask: Will LinkedIn grant the Lead Sync API access requested on 02.10.2026?
linkedinLeadSync.why: Without it LinkedIn sends us nothing. The request was submitted by Ritvars for SIA Novikontas Jūras koledža; Microsoft vetting may write first. It can be refused.

mailchimp._note: Read from the live Mailchimp API. The API key lives in the Grand Opening hub .env.local and is never copied into this project. A Mailchimp event is ACTIVITY ABOUT SOMEBODY, not automatically a new person - a newsletter subscriber is not a lead.

whatsapp._note: The number is settled. What remains is the Meta build: WhatsApp Business Account, register this number against it, connect the app, point the webhook at us. None of that is a question for anybody at Novikontas.

gmail._note: Only Marina can grant domain-wide delegation. Our side is built: the poll route, the JWT assertion with sub=edu@novikontas.org, read-only scope, multipart flattening and watch expiry. What is left is twenty minutes of her time and the key file, which comes by password manager or in person and never by chat or email.

_stageMoveNote: Q15, Ritvars 05.10.2026: 'Going back and in overall moving stages should be documented, so notes box its for this.' A move back needs a note, a move forward asks and can be skipped; a note or logged call in the last recentMinutes counts (his popup). enforce stays false until he picks A or B; the ?movenote=a|b switch sends the rule itself. Reasons are neutral placeholders for Ieva to tune.
_closedTags: Ieva, 30.09.2026, in her own words: 'pie not proceeding katram ir iespeja pievienot, piemeram, tag - cold, reject'. This is a SECOND axis and not a second reason list. closedReason says WHY we stopped. closedTag says WHAT NOW: is this person dormant and expected back, or declined. She needs it for statistics and to aim marketing at the cold ones.

closedTags.label: Cold
closedTags.what: No next activity, on purpose. Not rejected. A cold one sometimes becomes an active lead again.

closedTags.label: Reject
closedTags.what: Declined, and often only for now: somebody who cannot yet, for example still at secondary school. The contact is kept.
